name: zimage_invalidate_loaded_variant_chain
description: zImage::InvalidateLoadedVariantChain releases loaded variant images until the chain ends or reaches a non-loaded entry, clears image pointers, and marks invalidated entries pending reload.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Functional coverage is through zClass node material invalidation, which exercises the loaded-entry and stop-at-non-loaded-entry behavior needed by callers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja HLIL for 0x46e250 validates null input return, loop while loadState is 1, ReleaseIfNotDefault call, image pointer clearing, loadState 3 assignment, and traversal through nextVariant.
The native smoke verifies a loaded texture directory entry is invalidated and released while a following non-loaded/default entry remains unchanged.
